retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast holiday portrait featuring a central subject framed by mistletoe against a saturated red backdrop with layered retro typography and starburst accents.
triggerTerms: retro script and sans-serif holiday layout

recipe.visualDefinition: A glamorous close-up portrait of a blonde woman with red lips, partially obscured by a hanging sprig of mistletoe with white berries and a red bow. The composition is set against a vibrant red background, featuring white retro-style script and condensed sans-serif typography, accented by four-pointed starbursts and a vertical decorative sidebar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's red lips and bow echoing the saturated red background
Green mistletoe providing a complementary color contrast to the red field
White typography and starbursts creating a clean, high-contrast layer over the warm tones
Vertical sidebar (obi strip) balancing the right-aligned tracklist
coreInvariants: Mistletoe sprig with white berries and red bow
High-glam makeup with bold red lips
Mix of elegant script and condensed block lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders, filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the hanging mistletoe sprig.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes/mistletoe, moves to the large script title at the top right, then down the tracklist, ending at the vertical sidebar on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subject, foliage, and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds, high value contrast between white text and dark red background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of fluid brush script and geometric condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: High contrast, looping ascenders, connected glyphs
Sans-serif: Ultra-condensed, uniform stroke width, squared corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the script 'G' and 'S'
Starburst icons integrated into the text layout
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for elegance and personality paired with condensed sans-serif for information density and retro-modern feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, mid-century brush style of the main title.
Captures the ultra-condensed, bold look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a glamorous blonde woman with red lipstick against a solid red background. A sprig of mistletoe with green leaves, white berries, and a red ribbon bow should hang in front of her face, partially obscuring one eye.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white brush-script title in the top right. Below it, add a list of song titles in a white, ultra-condensed bold sans-serif font, right-aligned. Include small four-pointed starburst icons around the text. Add a vertical decorative strip on the far left edge with gold and green accents.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated red?
Is the mistletoe positioned over the subject's face?
Are the fonts a mix of script and condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific song titles in the list
mustRedesign: Exact Japanese text on the sidebar
postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of the condensed text
Ensure the mistletoe looks integrated into the scene
Verify the red background is uniform and vibrant
Confirm the starbursts are sharp and geometric
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a glamorous holiday portrait with a saturated red backdrop, then layer white retro script and condensed sans-serif text using a right-aligned hierarchy, accented by mid-century starbursts.
